method: Existing direct public Roadview observation screenshots reviewed again and compared with the actual game; additional public photographs searched and visually inspected. No source panorama or photograph pixels distributed in game.

scope.playable: Same three zones and connecting routes as walk-r21. Background-only areas are not new walking destinations.
scope.renderMargin: 35m fully opaque plus40m atmospheric fade; the source map remains unchanged.
scope.notRestored: All other campus buildings and sports ground models remain excluded.

observations.source: Saved Kakao Roadview student-road-axis-2026-03.png and gate-current-jnuri-20260224.jpg
observations.observed: Wide vehicle entrance, narrower two-lane internal road, arrows/diamond markings, curbside trees and sidewalk behind planting strip.
observations.change: Entrance17.5m tapers to7.4m internal estimate. Rendering and surface-height sampling share this width profile. Road source coordinates unchanged.
observations.estimated: All widths, taper transition z=-390..-230, marking positions, tree offsets and sizes.

observations.source: Saved public Kakao Roadview library-road-bus-stop-2026-03.png, plus2023 public photograph at https://mostadmired.tistory.com/238
observations.observed: Wooded roadside sidewalk, dark-frame glazed bus shelter, paved forecourt and wide entrance stairs.
observations.change: Independent original shelter/bench/frame/papers geometry and north-side sidewalk. Local front-court pad now uses coarse-raster reference near the court instead of building-centre median to reduce a hump.
observations.estimated: Shelter location x=-143,z=199.9, dimensions, bench, notice layouts, exact sidewalk width, reconstructed court elevation. Not a surveyed/precise shelter pin.

observations.observed: Low irregular basalt retaining edge, gray pavers, yellow tactile strip and planting bank.
observations.change: 200 independently generated irregular basalt stones replace repeated square wall blocks. Existing pavers/tactile strip and facade kept.

observations.source: OSM park969694343 and pond969694342, plus saved Roadview student-road-axis-2026-03.png
observations.observed: OSM records a pond/park north of the student hall; Roadview shows brown guard railing and evergreen planting near the approach.
observations.change: Pond restored at original outline, original coarse-source median used for a flat water surface and local blended banks; brown park-side railing added.
observations.estimated: Water elevation/bank grade, fence exact placement x=-99.2,z=-71..-38 and all fence dimensions. Fence does not claim an exact photographed alignment.

observations.observed: Cream facade, red tiled roof, classical four-column portico, front gables and upper arched windows.
observations.change: Independent portico/column/gable/arch geometry on existing OSM footprint. Other sides repeat prior facade assumptions.
observations.estimated: Roof form, storey heights, proportions and unseen rear.2023 view may predate changes.

observations.observed: Public entrance photo shows trunks and multiple fine branches, not repeated large Y-shaped forks.
observations.change: Thinner tapered trunks with three main and six secondary branches; canopy size reduced. OSM woodland area selection retained. Grainy alpha-hash border removed in favour of opaque-depth fog-colour edge.
observations.estimated: Every individual tree location/height/crown, reconstructed leaf patterns and a leafy-season presentation. Historical leafless Roadview season is not exactly replicated.

unresolved: Only the named selected and adjacent buildings were reviewed; missing nearby unobserved buildings are not claimed complete.
All environment is independent visual reconstruction; it is not photogrammetry, a complete photoreal reconstruction, or a survey.
No measured curb, stair, water-level or building-height dataset was acquired.
preserved: Avatar, walking/running, jump, first/third person, collisions, UI and walking boundary
